notes.title: Close-Aplha 0.2 update
notes.notes:
As soon as the first trial version of the closed-alpha version of the game was released, you could find quite a large number of bugs that we missed during the development of the game.

We promptly tried to solve most of them, there is a list of changed ones below:

[list]
[*] Doors in the lab on level 0 now have collision
[*] Added description of each map in the main menu
[*] Prohibited character movement during the initial cutscene on level 1
[*] Removed lockers on level 2 that were obstructing the walkway
[*] Added 2 sounds in the cutscene on level 0
[*] Slightly changed main menu
[*] Reduced camera movement speed in the main menu
[*] Added collisions on level 2
[*] Removed line trace (red bars that appear when you press E).
[*] Changed level 37
[/list]

Thank you for helping us find bugs so quickly, we really appreciate your willingness to help in the development of the project !

notes.title: Closed Alpha Test
notes.notes:
The development team of BackRooms X is pleased to announce the launch of the closed alpha version of the game.

This is a significant milestone in the project's development, and we invite a limited number of players to be among the first to evaluate key gameplay aspects and help us improve the game ahead of its full release.

Participation in the testing is limited. Access to the alpha version will be granted via special keys, which can be obtained through official giveaways and events hosted on our Discord channel.

If you wish to become part of the testing community and contribute to the development of BackRooms X, stay tuned for updates in our official communities and on the game's Steam page.

Your feedback and suggestions are extremely important to us. Together, we can make BackRooms X a truly unique game in the backrooms genre.

Thank you for your support!
The BackRooms X Team.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wCODL0iEySY
